scope: local ARM64 Mac/Docker 80k-user four-shard whole-configuration comparison of portable/corrected PR31 and W2/ARTICLE1; not an official score or capacity search

configuration.reference_disclosure: PR31 pinned at 43e0919ae5b693c1d3c1e8828b74bb774ef92ee0; local portable/correctness-corrected derivative, not its original x86 binary or an official PR31 score. Repairs are ARM/slice/epoll ABI adaptation, reliable bcrypt pipe reply delivery, PostgreSQL<=95 guard, and committed-favorite response correctness; the same pinned compiler and GCC optimization flags are used. Original pure-Goose JSON/HMAC and default WORKERS=4/PG_READERS=3/HASHERS=2 remain. Candidate WORKERS=2/ARTICLE_BATCH=1 changes configuration as well as native primitives, so this is a whole-configuration comparison.

protocol.paired_random_stream: same native run-id and VU ids within each pair; fresh DBs prevent name collisions
protocol.warmup: none; this is a fixed-load diagnostic, not the official warmup/search/hold protocol
protocol.invalid_policy: native lg_limited or failed infrastructure is INVALID; retain, never replace
protocol.interpretation: at fixed unsaturated load, compare latency/CPU; similar req/s cannot establish capacity

proposal_label: Portable/corrected PR31 default W4 vs frozen native Goose W2/ARTICLE1 whole-configuration comparison
preconditions: The active W2/ARTICLE1 versus Rust study finishes, all attempts remain retained, and its independent audit outcome is known before this study begins. Rust acceptance cannot be inferred from provisional pairs.
Both frozen binaries retain their recorded SHA256. The portable reference passed the unchanged dev/full197 suites, and the exact candidate binary passed the full197 suite with W2/ARTICLE1.
No source, app defaults, compiler, database settings, or protocol changes are included. Freeze and verify the unchanged existing v3 controller/helpers before execution.

Before evaluating this separate study, independently freeze an auditor revision that recognizes this explicitly disclosed whole-configuration WORKERS4-to2 difference; do not weaken equal PG_READERS/HASHERS/common load/resource checks. The active-study auditor remains untouched.
Root decides whether to execute after the current study and any separately justified default decision. Preparing this plan does not authorize a benchmark process.

preregistered_acceptance.claims_scope: Local fixed 80k-user whole-configuration diagnostic against the disclosed portable/corrected PR31 reference only; no official PR31 score, capacity, ranking, implementation-only attribution, or all-competitor superiority claim.
preregistered_acceptance.hypothesis: The W2/ARTICLE1 configuration may lower combined app+PostgreSQL CPU and latency relative to the PR31 default configuration by combining fewer database backends, live article SQL sharing, and native JSON/HMAC. This study measures the complete configurations and cannot determine the contribution of any individual difference.
preregistered_acceptance.clean_pair_definition: All 6 prescheduled attempts classify PASS, with zero HTTP/socket/timeout errors, valid frozen target/load/host witnesses, no target OOM and zero target swap, all 80k VUs active, and no native generator-limited verdict. Existing v3 host-memory criteria are unchanged. Invalid/failing attempts are retained and block acceptance; never replace them selectively.

metric.name: whole_target_cpu_seconds_per_successful_request
metric.scope: Combined app + PostgreSQL target cgroup, using the existing fully bracketed v3 target monitor. The CPU average uses the sampled interval inside the 60-second native request window. App-only CPU cannot substitute.
metric.limitation: CPU/request is a fixed-load sampled estimate; it does not measure maximum user capacity.

preregistered_acceptance.promotion_policy: A local improvement against this disclosed PR31 derivative may be claimed only if every pair passes the predeclared CPU/latency/cleanliness gates. This study cannot establish a Rust win: acceptance against Rust remains conditional on all three criteria of the separate frozen Rust study passing its completed audit. No source/default change, official rank, capacity claim, or all-competitor claim follows automatically.

candidate.json_hmac: native prepared OpenSSL HMAC and native SIMD JSON

whole_configuration_differences.attribution_limit: Any result applies to these complete frozen configurations; it cannot isolate native primitive improvements, worker count, or article batching.
